newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends flat, loses early gains.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends flat, loses early gains.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed flat at 42.5480/5490 to the dollar in interbank trading on Thursday.
The local unit was quoted at 42.5470/42.5490 per dollar in early trade but weakened later after investors squared their positions ahead of Moslem Friday weekend.
"Market had solid supply of dollar and initial deals were at 42.5470 level," said one dealer. "Sellers bargained at later half."

The call money was traded at 5.75 percent to 6.75 percent, up from Wednesday's 5.0-6.0 percent. Dealers said liquidity in banks was strained following Monday's auction of treasury bills worth about 1.45 billion taka by the central bank.
